en.title: 164 of 238 resorts in Italy have snow on top: the list
en.description: 164 of 238 resorts in Italy have snow on top: the list. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Italy on 21 November.
en.lede: 164 of the 238 resorts in Italy have snow on their upper slopes today. Pfelders leads with 29 cm.

p: Snow on the upper slopes is not the same as open runs: lifts open when the base is deep enough to groom, and the resort decides that.
The white area in Italy stands at about 24,510 km² today, about the same as yesterday. Roughly 26 % of the country's mapped mountains and hills are covered.
Pfelders leads with 118 cm on its upper slopes.
Close behind: La Thuile ski (72 cm), Courmayeur (67 cm), Prali (57 cm) and Pila ski (55 cm).
At Pfelders: 15 cm of fresh snow over three days, 11 cm more expected by Tuesday 24 November.
At La Thuile ski: 97 cm of fresh snow over three days, 71 cm more expected by Tuesday 24 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 164 out of 238 resorts in Italy.

The rest of the shortlist: Courmayeur: 67 cm on top, 105 cm in three days, 76 cm expected; Prali: 57 cm on top, 24 cm in three days, 23 cm expected; Pila ski: 55 cm on top, 53 cm in three days, 36 cm expected.

sections.h: From the valleys to the summits
p: Climb and the snow gets deeper: 500-1,000 m: on average under 1 cm (1 % of the ground white); 1,000-1,500 m: on average under 1 cm (17 % of the ground white); 1,500-2,000 m: on average 3 cm (66 % of the ground white); 2,000-2,500 m: on average 11 cm (94 % of the ground white); above 2,500 m: on average 27 cm (99 % white).
The week ahead could bring up to 62 cm, 40 cm of it in the next three days.
The snowiest day looks like Sunday 22 November, with up to 37 cm in the snowiest spots.
Further out, days 8 to 14 show up to 23 cm on the snowiest slopes.
Snow cover in Italy over the last days: 16 November 21,210 km²; 17 November 17,790 km²; 18 November 19,640 km²; 19 November 24,470 km²; 20 November 20,940 km²; 21 November 24,510 km².
The deepest resort changed hands 4 times this week.

sections.h: What it means on the slopes
p: The new snow freshens the upper slopes; lower down it may already be heavy or wet.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.
Compared with 19,930 km² seven days ago, that is 4,580 km² more. Below about 1,500 m the slopes are mostly green or brown.

sections.h: New snow in the last three days
p: Three-day totals peak at 55 cm, around the Aosta Valley, the Piedmont Alps and the central Apennines.
In the past day, up to 8 cm was added.
At least 5 cm fell over some 20,450 km².

Resort by resort, today against a normal 21 November: Pfelders: 29 cm at about 2,050 m, against 25 cm in a normal year; La Thuile ski: 79 cm at about 2,038 m, against 28 cm in a normal year; Courmayeur: 84 cm at about 1,976 m, against 25 cm in a normal year; Prali: 19 cm at about 2,173 m, against 17 cm in a normal year.
4 of these 4 resorts are above their usual depth for the date.
These depths are for one height on each mountain, below the top, so they read lower than the upper-slope numbers further down.
In past winters the best snow at Pfelders usually came late February / early March.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Austria: 56 % white, deepest Stubaier Gletscher with 63 cm, up to 35 cm in the week ahead; Switzerland: 64 % white, deepest Anzère with 86 cm, up to 74 cm in the week ahead.

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Above 2,000 m the ground is almost fully white (94 % covered), so runs up there have a continuous base.
Between 1,500 m and 2,000 m the cover is patchy, about 66 % white: expect grass and stones between the snow.
Below 1,000 m the slopes are still almost bare.
If you can choose the day, go after Sunday 22 November: the fresh snow then has time to settle and the roads to be cleared.

advice: Snow above the tree line can be wind-packed: watch the ridges.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.
Roads to the higher resorts may need winter tyres or chains.

it.title: Situazione neve in Italia, 21 novembre 2026: località, neve fresca e prossimi giorni
it.description: Neve in Italia il 21 novembre: manto nevoso, neve fresca, altezza per quota, prossimi giorni e migliori località.
it.lede: In Italia oggi circa 24.510 km² sono innevati (sabato 21 novembre). La superficie è quasi la stessa di ieri.

p: Rispetto ai 19.930 km² di sette giorni fa, un aumento di 4.580 km². Il terreno è per lo più bianco da circa 1.500 m in su.

sections.h: Dove è caduta la neve fresca
p: I cumulati di tre giorni arrivano a 55 cm. Di più: Valle d'Aosta, Alpi piemontesi e Appennino centrale.
Solo nelle ultime 24 ore sono caduti fino a 8 cm.

L'altezza della neve dipende dalla quota: 500–1.000 m: in media meno di 1 cm (1 % innevato); 1.000–1.500 m: in media meno di 1 cm (17 % innevato); 1.500–2.000 m: in media 3 cm (66 % innevato); 2.000–2.500 m: in media 11 cm (94 % innevato); sopra i 2.500 m: in media 27 cm (99 % innevato).
La neve fresca sul fondo regala curve morbide in quota; più in basso resta a chiazze.
La settimana può portare fino a 62 cm, di cui fino a 40 cm nei prossimi tre giorni.
Il giorno più nevoso: domenica, 22 novembre, fino a 37 cm.
Più avanti, nei giorni 8–14, sui pendii più innevati possono aggiungersi fino a 23 cm.
Più neve sulle piste in quota: Pfelders, 118 cm.
Località con neve sulle piste in quota: 164 su 238.
Seguono: La Thuile ski (72 cm), Courmayeur (67 cm), Prali (57 cm) e Pila ski (55 cm).
La Thuile ski: 97 cm di neve fresca in tre giorni e fino a 71 cm in più entro martedì, 24 novembre.

advice: Prima di partire verificate che gli impianti siano aperti.
